2. **Báo cáo Thường niên ngành Điện Việt Nam 2023** (EVN)  
   - *Location:* Chapter 2 (Thermal Power Generation), pp. 42–49  
   - *URL:* https://www.evn.com.vn/vi/vi/hoat-dong/10-bao-cao-thuong-nien/1001-bao-cao-thuong-nien-nganh-dien-viet-nam-2023  
3. **Báo cáo Hiện trạng Phát triển Ngành Công Thương Việt Nam 2022** (Bộ Công Thương)  
   - *Location:* Chapter 4 (Năng lượng), Section 4.2 (Sản xuất điện)  
   - *URL:* https://moit.gov.vn/Portals/0/bao-cao-hien-trang-phat-trien-nganh-cong-thuong-2022.pdf  

### Notes on Data & Methodology
- **Threshold:** Only units ≥30 MWe are included. Smaller backup/diesel units are excluded.
- **Status Definitions:** Reflect PDP8 (2023) regulatory stance. "Suspended" indicates projects removed from the approved pipeline but not legally terminated. "Planned" denotes projects retained for future review contingent on LNG infrastructure and demand forecasts.
- **Technology:** All listed coal plants are subcritical; none have reached supercritical/USC status in Vietnam. Gas plants are predominantly CCGT; OCGT units are excluded as they fall below 30 MWe or are used for peaking only.
- **Fuel Transition:** PDP8 explicitly prioritizes imported LNG over domestic gas for new thermal assets to preserve gas for industrial/export use. Existing domestic gas plants are slated for gradual retirement or fuel-switching studies.
- **COD Accuracy:** Dates reflect actual commercial operation for operational plants. Future dates are estimates based on PDP8 implementation timelines and may shift with EPC contracts, grid interconnection approvals, or financing closures.
- **Verification:** Cross-referenced with MOIT licensing databases, EVN asset registers, and World Bank/ADB energy sector assessments. Minor discrepancies may exist due to phased commissioning or unit de-rating for maintenance.

This inventory provides a primary-sourced baseline for policy analysis, investment tracking, and decarbonization planning. For real-time project updates, consult the MOIT Electricity Regulatory Authority (ERA) portal and EVN's quarterly investment reports.
